liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Birthday Boy (3:48)** (1 review): The listener had long awaited the electric guitar solo performance of this specific track [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Piano Intro -> (2:29)**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [7]
- **Spinal Menengitis (3:26)**: back after 41 archived shows (590 days) [7]
- **Don't Squeal On the Pusher (11:19)**: rare: 5 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **ween2009-09-04.akg460.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 33 songs; 154 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: PA distortion and crackling are present in the first ten tracks of the recording [1]
- **ween2009-09-04.KM184s**: source not stated; 32 songs; 155 min [2]
- **ween2009-09-04.AKG483**: source not stated; 32 songs; 155 min [3]

## Around the show

- The reviewer described the venue as amazing and expressed hope for the band's return [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2009-09-04.akg460.flac16**: transferred by jbanyai97; source: AKG ck61|c460b > Segue Dogstar XLRs > Fostex FR-2LE (24bit/48khz) [1]. Also: Recorded from the right of the SBD cage, five feet from the right of center [1]
- **ween2009-09-04.KM184s**: taped by Chris King; transferred by Chris King; source: NeumannKM 184s> R44 Oade (Concert Mod) (24/96) [2]
- **ween2009-09-04.AKG483**: taped by Chris King; transferred by Chris King; source: AKG483s > Grace Design Lunatec V3 Spdif> R44 Oade (Concert Mod) (24/96) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Ween Vintage Concert Silkscreen from Pine Mountain Amphitheatre, Sep 4, 2009 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/posters-handbills-and-postcards/ween/silkscreen/PAZ090904.html) [8]
